description:
Variation of Condition 1 (Drawings) of reserved matters details relating to the approval of access; appearance; landscaping; layout and scale in respect of Phases 4b, 4c and 4d (Development Plots H1 and H2); for the erection of two buildings comprising residential and non-residential floorspace with associated landscaping approved under 2024/01420/RES granted 17 January 2025 of planning permission 2018/02100/COMB granted 8 February 2019 (as amended by refs 2020/01088/NMAT and 2024/00818/NMAT);
                                                                                                                                                                                                        "Planning Application (part-detailed, part-outline) for demolition of existing buildings and structures (excl. No.2 Gasholder, 1856 Chief Engineer's Office, 1927 Research Laboratory, 1920 WW1 War Memorial and WW2 War Memorial) and redevelopment to provide a residential-led mixed use development comprising the erection of new buildings.

 

(1) Detailed planning application for residential floorspace together with ancillary residential facilities (C3 Use); flexible commercial floorspace (A1, A2, A3, A4 Uses); community and leisure floorspace (D1/D2 Use); provision of a basement; new pedestrian and vehicular access; provision of amenity space, landscaping, car/cycle parking, refuse storage, energy centre, servicing area, and other associated infrastructure works.

(2) Outline planning application (with all matters reserved) for residential floorspace and ancillary residential facilities (C3 Use); non-residential floorspace comprising flexible commercial retail (A1, A2, A3, A4 Uses), office (B1 Use), community (D1 Use) and leisure (D2 Use) floorspace; provision of new basement level; new pedestrian and vehicular access; and associated amenity space, publicly accessible open space, landscaping, car/cycle parking, refuse storage, energy centres, servicing area, and other associa
